items.title: Harold Danko interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, April 28, 2021
items.q: Leonard Bernstein in one of the nice YouTube clips where he’s teaching “Rite of Srping” to some young people

ctx.x: I had the good fortune to interview Chubby Jackson. And he talked about that, that session, trying to play and Stravinsky’s up there. They were so, I think, challenged by that experience.

Hopefully that’s the spirit I’m bringing, you know, even when I do my gig tomorrow night. It ain’t going to be perfect. And one of the inspiring things, I talked about a few things in the liner notes that inspired me, but when I first heard, because I’d heard denigrating things about the Woody Herman version of “Ebony Concerto.” Okay? And then I heard, I got one of these CD collections that had it there and it had some photos of Stravinsky with the guys. And Stravinsky’s got his little like PF Flyer looking shoes…
